 Vikings Terminate Contract of Odell Beckham, Jr. During Roster Moves
 Nov 10, 2026 at 03:32 PM Craig Peters Editing Director & Quality Control
 Copied! 
 EAGAN, Minn. — The Vikings on Tuesday announced they have terminated the contract of receiver Odell Beckham, Jr.
 Beckham made his Vikings debut Monday after signing from Minnesota's practice squad. He only played two snaps on a night when the offense struggled to find rhythm.
 Beckham will be eligible to return to the Vikings practice squad.
 The Vikings also released guard C.J. Hanson and tackle Corey Robinson II from their practice squad.
